verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing runs billing-domain automations in the background. It handles recurring charges, renewals and trials on its own, Smart Retries automatically retry failed payments, and 'Stripe Billing automations' control customer communications. Webhooks push real-time events to external systems, which can act on them. However, the automations are limited to built-in billing workflows, and the evidence does not show a general-purpose or agent-driven way to define custom background automations. Missing for 10: documentation of how users configure custom automation triggers and actions, agent-native or AI-driven automation setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
